title: Mechanism for conveying an article
abstract: A pusher mechanism for pushing bottles formed in an 1. S. machine 5 from a dead plate to a conveyor. The pusher mechanism includes a pusher finger assembly which is supported by a housing and is movable about an axis of support and about the parallel axis of rotation of the housing. A pair of servo motors effect the desired rotation of the two axes through cam profiles each of which has at least one Bezier curve segment with a parameter of one 10 curve linked to a parameter of the other curve.
